description: Three-band parametric equalizer from Surge, each band with a gain, a centre frequency and a bandwidth, and a master gain over the three.

params.text: Sets the gain of the first band, -48dB to 48dB.
Sets the centre frequency of the first band, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the bandwidth of the first band, 0 to 5 octaves.
Sets the gain of the second band, -48dB to 48dB.
Sets the centre frequency of the second band, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the bandwidth of the second band, 0 to 5 octaves.
Sets the gain of the third band, -48dB to 48dB.
Sets the centre frequency of the third band, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the bandwidth of the third band, 0 to 5 octaves.
Sets the output level of the equalizer, -48dB to 48dB.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Freq knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the BW knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.

Adds to the Master Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Preset — four factory settings: Init, Air, Mid Cut and Smiley Curve.
Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
